fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: The Fax service attempts to load ualapi.dll, which is non-existent. An attacker can then (side)load their own malicious DLL using this service.
fields.name: Fax Service DLL Search Order Hijack
fields.query: event.type="ModuleLoad" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((src.process.image.path contains "\fxssvc.exe" and module.path contains "ualapi.dll") and (not module.path contains "C:\Windows\WinSxS\")))
